_comment: Expert-curated Unified Control <-> regulatory requirement mappings, keyed by the REAL ingested requirement_key. Loaded as state=EXPERT_REVIEWED, proposed_by=HUMAN, mapping_source=expert_curated. These DO count toward coverage. Reviewed against the primary sources; legal_review_status stays NOT_REVIEWED until counsel signs off.

mappings.rationale: Article 9 mandates a continuous, documented AI risk management system over the lifecycle - the direct obligation UC-AI-RSK-001 operationalises.
Art. 9(2) enumerates the risk management steps (identification, estimation, evaluation of residual risk).
Art. 9(5) requires risk management measures such that residual risk is judged acceptable.
Art. 10(1)-(3) data governance for training/validation/testing data sets.
Art. 10(2) data governance and management practices.
Art. 10(3) requires relevant, representative, error-free data sets - the basis for bias/fairness evaluation.
Art. 11 + Annex IV technical documentation is the system-of-record UC-AI-INV-001 maintains.
Art. 11(1) technical documentation drawn up before placing on the market and kept up to date.
Art. 12(3) logging capabilities enabling traceability of the system's functioning.
Art. 13(1) transparency and provision of information to deployers.
Art. 13(2) instructions for use content overlaps with the inventory/documentation record.
Art. 14(1) effective human oversight during the period the system is in use.
Art. 14(4) oversight measures: understand, monitor, interpret, decide not to use, intervene.
Art. 14(4)(e) requires the ability to intervene or interrupt via a 'stop' button or similar - the UC-AI-AGT-002 kill switch.
Art. 15(1) appropriate level of accuracy over the lifecycle.
Art. 15(4) resilience against errors/faults and adversarial attempts to manipulate - pre-deployment adversarial testing.
Art. 15(5) cybersecurity, including resilience to data/model poisoning and adversarial examples.
Art. 17 quality management system - the governing policy/process framework UC-AI-GOV-001 establishes.
Art. 19 retention of automatically generated logs under the provider's control.
Art. 26 deployer obligations require assigned human oversight and organisational measures - governance roles.
Art. 5(1) prohibited AI practices - the screen UC-AI-INV-002 enforces at intake.
Art. 50(1) natural persons must be informed they are interacting with an AI system.
Art. 50(2) synthetic audio/image/video/text must be marked as artificially generated in a machine-readable way.
Art. 72 post-market monitoring system feeding incident detection.
Art. 73 serious incident reporting to market surveillance authorities.
Art. 73(2) reporting timelines for serious incidents.
GDPR accuracy principle - personal data must be accurate and kept up to date; overlaps AI output accuracy where outputs are personal data.
GDPR accountability principle - the controller must be able to demonstrate compliance; governance ownership.
Data protection by default - only personal data necessary for each purpose is processed (data minimisation).
Records of processing activities - the register UC-AI-INV-001 keeps for AI systems processing personal data.
Security of processing - appropriate technical measures including protection against unlawful alteration (poisoning/tampering).
Art. 32 also implies a process to keep security measures current - vulnerability and patch management.
DPIA obligation - Art. 35 processing likely to result in high risk requires a data protection impact assessment.
OWASP LLM01:2026 Prompt Injection maps directly to the prompt-injection defence control.
OWASP LLM02:2026 Sensitive Information Disclosure - input/output data minimisation and redaction.
OWASP LLM02:2026 also addressed by output filtering/sanitisation.
OWASP LLM03:2026 Excessive Agency maps directly to least-privilege / tool-permission scoping.
OWASP LLM04:2026 Supply Chain - third-party model/dataset/plugin provider due diligence.
OWASP LLM04:2026 mitigations include an AI bill of materials / component inventory.
OWASP LLM05:2026 Data and Model Poisoning maps directly to the poisoning-defence control.
OWASP LLM06:2026 Unbounded Consumption - rate limiting, quotas and graceful degradation.
OWASP LLM08:2026 Hidden Context Exposure - control over what data enters the model context.
OWASP LLM10:2026 Improper Output Handling maps directly to the insecure-output-handling control.
OWASP Agentic ASI01 Agent Goal Hijack - human confirmation gates on consequential actions.
OWASP Agentic ASI01 goal manipulation is frequently achieved via (indirect) prompt injection.
OWASP Agentic ASI02 Tool Misuse and Exploitation - least privilege and tool permission scoping.
OWASP Agentic ASI04 Agentic Supply Chain - provider and dependency due diligence.
AI RMF GOVERN 1.1 - legal and regulatory requirements understood, managed and documented in policy.
AI RMF GOVERN 2.1 - roles, responsibilities and lines of communication documented.
AI RMF MAP 1.1 - intended purpose, context and categorisation recorded per system.
AI RMF MEASURE 2.3 - AI system performance/assurance measured against defined metrics.
AI RMF MEASURE 2.7 - AI system security and resilience evaluated (adversarial/red-team testing).
AI RMF MEASURE 2.11 - fairness and bias evaluated and results documented.
AI RMF MANAGE 2.4 - mechanisms to supersede, disengage or deactivate systems that demonstrate performance/outcome issues.
